answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed on proven misbehavior. A Sybil attacker then faces a cost spiral: each fake identity needs its own locked stake, so spawning thousands of sock puppets ties up capital like stacking timber — every new plank costs real money and can be burned. Honest agents instead reach their zenith by growing reputation on one bonded identity, making fakery expensive and honesty profitable.
